author: Bryan Guffey
message:
fix: address CodeRabbit review — all 10 comments

Actionable:
- /api/invited: per-IP fixed-window rate limit (20/min on PROFILE_CACHE
  KV, exhausted budget answers the invited:true non-answer) + 3s timeout
  on the appview resolver fetch
- SignInSheet: pending search debounce cleared when the sheet closes so
  it can't reopen the dropdown; combobox a11y — options are real
  role=option elements with ids (no nested interactive button),
  aria-activedescendant on the input, arrow keys scroll the highlighted
  option into view
- YouItem: leaving the ZIP shape invalidates in-flight lookups (seq bump
  + status reset); lookup status messages are a role=status live region

Nitpicks:
- KnownUser type moved to $lib/types (route module decoupled from client
  component)
- deadlineStatus() shared helper — page and response API can no longer
  disagree about closed-ness or the displayed date
- canonicalize redirects with 308 (PUT keeps method+body) and guards
  ORIGIN with URL.canParse
- vite ssr conditions keep Vite's defaults behind workerd/worker;
  verified the bundle still resolves @atcute workerd builds (no bare
  Buffer internals present)

author: Bryan Guffey
message:
fix: code-review findings — invited-endpoint hardening, Enter semantics, sealed-feed inert, ZIP race

- /api/invited resolves handles via public.api.bsky.app only (actorToDid
  would fetch https://<caller-string>/.well-known/atproto-did — an open
  request-forgery primitive on an unauthenticated endpoint) and validates
  handle/DID shape before touching anything
- Enter now advances from focused answer controls (place cards, radios)
  instead of re-activating them — Enter on a just-ranked location was
  un-ranking it while the chip promised 'press Enter'; also makes the
  affordance real on interest/travel where radio focus swallowed it
- sealed feed gets inert on non-hero items: overflow:hidden alone still
  let Tab-focus scroll the feed and screen readers read everything
- ZIP lookup debounced 400ms with staleness + sequence guards — no more
  clobbering a ZIP+4 mid-keystroke; retyping the same ZIP works again
- abr_known cookie only set for allowed users, strict shape/length checks
  on read (it renders in the sheet and seeds login())
- typeahead results deduped by handle (keyed each crashed on dupes);
  dropdown closes on focusout and resets when the sheet closes, so a
  stale dropdown can't block window Escape
- response API's closed message derives its date from the DEADLINE
  binding instead of hardcoding August 15

author: Bryan Guffey
message:
fix: review findings — never falsely deny invited users, log swallowed errors

Silent-failure review of the branch found that infrastructure hiccups
could masquerade as 'you're not on the list':
- page gate now fails OPEN on D1 errors or unresolved identity (the
  response API re-enforces authoritatively on write) and logs every
  swallowed error to Workers observability
- /api/invited answers the non-answer (invited:true) when handle
  resolution fails, instead of a confident wrong denial from a
  handle-only match against a possibly-stale stored handle
- restoreLocal's catch uses clearLocal so a storage SecurityError can't
  rethrow and abort onMount (killing scroll-spy + keyboard nav)

Data-side (already live): all 19 allowlist rows now have DIDs pre-pinned,
so DID-only matching works even when profile/handle resolution is down.

message:
feat: location no-preference option for folks who don't know the spots

A 'no-preference' sentinel travels in the existing ranking array (and the
location_ranking JSON column — no migration). It's mutually exclusive with
a real ranking: picking it clears ranks, ranking a place clears it, and
the server rejects a mixed payload. Dashed-border toggle under the place
list; review page shows 'No preference'.

feat: linkify organizer mentions via aturi.to profile waypoint

Every 'DM @chaosgreml.in' mention (hero invite-only + closed notes, sign-in

author: Bryan Guffey
message:
feat: pre-flight invite check on handle submit — uninvited handles learn before the PDS auth dance

New GET /api/invited?handle= resolves the handle to a DID (so pinned DIDs
still match after handle changes) and peeks the allowlist read-only. The
sign-in sheet calls it before login(); an uninvited handle gets the polite
invite-only note inline instead of a full OAuth round-trip. Every failure
mode (endpoint down, resolution failed, no DB) fails open — real
enforcement stays server-side after auth.

author: Bryan Guffey
message:
fix: enforce allowlist at sign-in, not just submit

A non-invited account (e.g. atproto.la) could sign in and browse the whole
survey, only hitting the allowlist 403 at final submit. The page load now
checks the allowlist too: non-invited sign-ins keep the feed sealed and see
the polite invite-only note on the hero (with sign-out). The API still
enforces on write as defense in depth.

author: Bryan Guffey
message:
feat: smoke-test feedback round — locked pre-auth feed, next affordances, ZIP lookup, handle typeahead, welcome-back, numeric-globe favicon

1. Signed-out feed is sealed at the hero: no scroll, rail dimmed to a faint
   map, dots hidden; everything unlocks at sign-in.
2. Every question grows a Next chip when answered; Enter advances (fields
   chain name→email→location→next).
3. Location field resolves 5-digit ZIPs to 'City, ST' via zippopotam.us,
   graceful fallback to free text.
4. Sign-in handle field is a typeahead (typeahead.waow.tech, debounced,
   keyboard-navigable, opens upward from the bottom sheet; degrades to a
   plain input if the experimental service is down). A 180-day identity-hint
   cookie greets returning visitors — 'Hey, it's you' — with one-tap
   continue, surviving logout.
5. Favicon: original numeric-globe homage to atproto.com's ASCII Earth.

author: Bryan Guffey
message:
fix: resolve workerd export conditions in Vite SSR build

Vite's SSR resolver defaults to node conditions, baking @atcute's
node-flavored builds (bare Buffer.prototype.base64urlSlice.call) into the
worker bundle; workerd's stricter Buffer polyfill throws 'The "start"
argument must be of type number' on every OAuth login. Resolve with
workerd/worker conditions so the packages' own pure-JS web builds ship.

Root-caused from Bryan's smoke-test HAR + local workerd repro.
